title: cordylanthus tenuis subsp. capillaris
intro: Cordylanthus tenuis subsp. capillaris, commonly known as Purple Needlegrass, is a perennial plant native to the western coast of North America. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Cordylanthus tenuis subsp. capillaris include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
